comment.nl: <remarkFreeTexts order="1"><title>Diversen</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Amendement 47 is om technische redenen geannuleerd.</translation></remarkFreeText><remarkFreeText><translation>De amendementen 56, 58, 95-101 en 104 zijn ingetrokken.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.pt: <remarkFreeTexts order="1"><title>Diversos</title><remarkFreeText><translation>A alteração 47 foi anulada por razões técnicas.</translation></remarkFreeText><remarkFreeText><translation>As alterações 56, 58, 95-101, 104 foram retiradas.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.en: <remarkFreeTexts order="1"><title>Miscellaneous</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Amendment 47 had been cancelled for technical reasons.</translation></remarkFreeText><remarkFreeText><translation>Amendments 56, 58, 95-101, 104 had been withdrawn.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.fr:
<remarkFreeTexts order="1"><title>Divers</title><remarkFreeText><translation>
L'amendement 47 a été annulé pour des raisons techniques.</translation></remarkFreeText><remarkFreeText><translation>Les amendments 56, 58, 95-101, 104 ont été retirés.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.cs: <remarkFreeTexts order="1"><title>Různé</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Pozměňovací návrh 47 byl zrušen z technických důvodů.</translation></remarkFreeText><remarkFreeText><translation>Pozměňovací návrhy 56, 58, 95-101, 104 byly vzaty zpět.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.da: <remarkFreeTexts order="1"><title>Diverse</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Ændringsforslag 47 blev annulleret af tekniske årsager.</translation></remarkFreeText><remarkFreeText><translation>Ændringsforslag 56, 58, 95-101, 104 var blevet trukket tilbage.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.lt: <remarkFreeTexts order="1"><title>Įvairūs</title><remarkFreeText><translation>47 pakeitimas buvo anuliuotas dėl techninių priežasčių.</translation></remarkFreeText><remarkFreeText><translation>56, 58, 95–101, 104 pakeitimai buvo atšaukti.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.lv: <remarkFreeTexts order="1"><title>Dažādi</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Grozījums Nr. 47 bija atcelts tehnisku iemeslu dēļ.</translation></remarkFreeText><remarkFreeText><translation>Grozījumi Nr. 56, 58, 95–101, 104 bija atsaukti.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.bg: <remarkFreeTexts order="1"><title>Разни</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Изменение 47 а се отменя по технически причини.</translation></remarkFreeText><remarkFreeText><translation>Изменения 56, 58, 95–101, 104 бяха оттеглени.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.sv: <remarkFreeTexts order="1"><title>Övrigt</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Ändringsförslag 47a hade utgått av tekniska skäl.</translation></remarkFreeText><remarkFreeText><translation>Ändringsförslagen 56, 58, 95-101, 104 hade dragits tillbaka.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.sl: <remarkFreeTexts order="1"><title>Razno</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Predlog spremembe 47 je bil razveljavljen zaradi tehničnih razlogov.</translation></remarkFreeText><remarkFreeText><translation>Predlogi sprememb 56, 58, 95–101, 104 so bili umaknjeni.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.ga: <remarkFreeTexts order="1"><title>Aon ghnó eile</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Rinneadh Leasú 47 a chealú ar chúiseanna teicniúla</translation></remarkFreeText><remarkFreeText><translation>Tarraingíodh siar leasuithe 56, 58, 95-101, 104</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.ro: <remarkFreeTexts order="1"><title>Diverse</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Amendamentul 47 a fost anulat din motive tehnice.</translation></remarkFreeText><remarkFreeText><translation>Amendamentele 56, 58, 95-101, 104 au fost retrase.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.de: <remarkFreeTexts order="1"><title>Verschiedenes</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Änderungsantrag 47 wurde aus technischen Gründen annulliert.</translation></remarkFreeText><remarkFreeText><translation>Die Änderungsanträge 56, 58, 95-101, 104 wurden zurückgezogen.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.hu: <remarkFreeTexts order="1"><title>Egyéb</title><remarkFreeText><translation>A 47. módosítást technikai okok miatt törölték.</translation></remarkFreeText><remarkFreeText><translation>Az 56., 58., 95–101. és 104. módosítást visszavonták.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.es: <remarkFreeTexts order="1"><title>Varios</title><remarkFreeText><translation>La enmienda 47 ha sido anulada por razones técnicas.</translation></remarkFreeText><remarkFreeText><translation>Las enmiendas 56, 58, 95-101 y 104 han sido retiradas.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.it: <remarkFreeTexts order="1"><title>Varie</title><remarkFreeText><translation>L'emendamento 47 è stato annullato per ragioni tecniche.</translation></remarkFreeText><remarkFreeText><translation>Gli emendamenti 56, 58, 95-101, 104 sono stati ritirati.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
